meta.name: azure-reliability
meta.description: Assess and improve the reliability posture of PaaS Applications (Azure Functions and Azure App Service). Scans deployed resources for zone redundancy, ZRS storage, health probes, and multi-region failover. Presents a feature-pivoted checklist, then drives staged remediation (CLI or IaC patches) end-to-end with user confirmation. WHEN: "assess reliability", "check reliability", "zone redundant", "multi-region failover", "high availability", "disaster recovery", "single points of failure", "reliability posture", "resiliency".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 评估并修复 Azure 应用的单点故障与灾难恢复短板
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你的 Azure 应用可能缺少区域冗余或健康探测
copy.tagline_en: Assess and fix single points of failure and disaster recovery gaps in Azure apps
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your Azure app may lack zone redundancy or health probes

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会扫描你的 Azure Functions 和 App Service 资源，检查区域冗余、存储冗余、健康探针与多区域故障转移，生成可靠性清单，并在你同意后通过 CLI 命令或修改 IaC 文件修复。
howto.when: 当用户提到“可靠性评估”、“区域冗余”、“多区域故障转移”等关键词，或要求检查/提升 Azure 应用可靠性时触发。仅适用于 Azure Functions 和 App Service 资源。

say.text: 帮我评估我的 Function App 的可靠性。
say.note: Claude 会扫描该应用并生成可靠性清单。

say.text: 让我的 App Service 支持区域冗余。
say.note: Claude 会提出修复方案并询问是否执行。

say.text: 设置我的应用的多区域故障转移。
say.note: Claude 会检查现有配置并给出步骤。

howto.what_en: On install, Claude can scan specified Azure Functions and App Service resources, assess zone redundancy, ZRS storage, health probes, and multi-region failover, present a feature-pivoted checklist, then propose fixes via CLI or IaC patches after user confirmation.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user mentions keywords like "reliability assessment", "zone redundancy", "multi-region failover", or asks to check/improve Azure app reliability. Only applies to Azure Functions and App Service resources.

say_en.text: Assess the reliability of my Function App.
say_en.note: Claude will scan the app and list findings.

say_en.text: Make my App Service zone redundant.
say_en.note: Claude will propose a fix and ask for approval.

say_en.text: Set up multi-region failover for my app.
say_en.note: Claude will check current setup and guide steps.
